title: Enterprise Connectivity: corrected net calculation
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this corrected net calculation rule to corrected monthly transfer assessment.

## Basis: outcome
For corrected monthly transfer assessment, multiply the positive nonincluded quantity by the selected unit rate, then reduce that whole subtotal once by the assisted review discount; round only the final corrected net subtotal half-up to the source tier’s monetary precision. The source must be US untaxed or verified exemption and have approved tax evidence, so tax component is zero.

## Basis Q&A
| Corrected monthly transfer assessment basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Corrected monthly transfer assessment: Multiply the positive nonincluded quantity by the selected unit rate, then reduce that whole subtotal once by the assisted review discount | round only the final corrected net subtotal half-up to the source tier’s monetary precision. The source must be US untaxed or verified exemption and have approved tax evidence, so tax component is zero. |

## Hypothetical calculation
Assume hypothetical positive nonincluded volume of 13 GB, selected unit price USD 0.37, reduction fraction 0.08 and monetary precision of two decimal places. The unrounded corrected subtotal is USD 4.4252; final half-up rounding gives USD 4.43. The reduction acts once on the whole USD 4.81 subtotal.
